answer: Require each agent to earn a nontransferable reputation through repeated, randomized tasks, with rewards held in escrow until independent peers verify the work. Weight influence by the age and diversity of verified interactions, not by account count; cap how much one newcomer cluster can sway a decision. A sybil operator must then fund many accounts, keep them active, and produce consistent useful work, while risking withheld rewards when caught. Like an ivory tower on shale, a cheap identity base cannot safely support a spiral of fabricated trust.
